Name: Wood Maker
Author: Wandox99
Description:
[b][center]NOW COMPATIBLE FOR 1.6[/center][/b]

Hello everyone!
This mod add a Wood Maker, you can buy it from Robin for 1000 gold.
Put an Acorn/Pine Cone or Maple Seed inside and it will make from 80 to 120 of woods.
Put an Mahogany/Mystic Tree Seed inside and it will make from 80 to 120 of Hardwood.
Put an Mushroom Tree Seed inside and it will make from 80 to 120 of Common Mushroom, Red Mushroom or Purple Mushroom.
Put an Mossy Seed inside and it will make from 80 to 120 of Wood or Fiddlehead Fern.
It need 7 days to be ready.


[b][size=3]Changelog:[/size][/b]
[b]1.1.0: [/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with 1.6;
[*]Added Mystic Tree and Mossy Seed as input for the Wood Maker;
[*]Due to technical issues, related to 1.6, the machine can no longer be animated, so it will only have two frames, while it is working or not: it will be one frame, while the other frame when it is ready. (Tryed for about 20h to fix this, there is no way I can fix it).  
[/list]
[size=5]Install[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.


[size=4]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]
